one_line: This is local, recurring portable toilet pump-out work in Dayton, OH, under NAICS 562991/PSC S214, which are not our codes. It sits outside our trailer-based fleet and pricing, we have no stated Ohio servicing presence, and quotes are due Monday, November 16, while today is Saturday and we have not seen the quote package.
scope: Five Rivers MetroParks (a local agency, not federal) wants quotes for renting and servicing portable toilets, Bid No. 26-020, with work in Dayton, OH. The estimated value is $25,000 to $120,000. The bid pack has no SOW, attachments, unit counts, service frequency, or contract term. Those details are only in the quote requirements package on the MetroParks website.
fit: Portable sanitation is one of our core competencies, under Facility Support & Utilities (company profile).

Denver contract SC-00011558 (Aug 2026 – ongoing) covers delivering and servicing restroom trailers, including cleaning, pump-outs, waste disposal, supplies, maintenance, and demobilization. This is the closest past performance.
USCG Station Lake Worth Inlet contract 70Z02826FMIAM0008 ($78,500) included restroom/shower trailers with water and wastewater support.
Our standard operations include weekly RCRA-compliant gray/black water removal, sanitizing, and consumables, plus a 24/7 emergency line.
The set-aside is NONE, so our status (SBE, MBE) does not block us. Our work area is nationwide.
red_flags: NAICS 562991 and PSC S214 are not among our NAICS codes (721310, 532490, 722310, 624230, 624221, 561210, 423740, and 532120 per the proposal template) or our PSCs (W023, W099, W045).
Deadline is November 16, 2026 at 5:00 PM local time. Today, November 14, 2026, is a Saturday, so we have about one business day.
The bid pack has 0 attachments. We have not seen the quote requirements, the contract document, or the submission email address.

The job is recurring local pump-out servicing in Dayton, OH. We are based in Marina del Rey, CA, and no Ohio depot or service trucks are documented. Servicing would probably need a local subcontractor we have not identified.

Our price list has no line for standard portable toilet units. The closest items are shower-restroom combination trailers ($2,995–$5,995) and the template's $8,995 restroom/shower trailer, which are a different product and likely too expensive for this work.
No contact information is given (Contact: None).
This is a low-margin commodity service where local providers that own pump trucks have a structural cost advantage.
competition: No incumbent was identified and the bid pack shows no past awards by Five Rivers MetroParks under NAICS 562991. The federal benchmarks list Sani-Can (2019, 1 offer) and Energica Spurghi Srl (2008–2009, 2 offers each). Those are unrelated small jobs in Alaska and Italy and tell us nothing about who competes in Dayton. [CONFIRM: incumbent and prior award amount, via a records request to FRMP or the bid tab]
price_signal: No useful benchmark exists. FRMP's estimate is $25,000–$120,000. The NAICS 562991/PSC S214 awards in the bid pack ($1,432 in 2019, $4,934 in 2009, $11,769 in 2008) are old, small, federal, and not in Ohio. Our price list has no portable toilet rates, so we could not price this from approved figures. [CONFIRM: unit rental and per-service rates]
